text: Ironvale Athletic's tactical adjustment to a low block and deep defensive line effectively neutralized Redmond Rovers' high press and quick circulation, allowing Ironvale to regain possession in less risky zones and launch efficient direct vertical counters. The pressing trigger for Ironvale was Redmond’s high defensive line, which created exploitable space behind, leading to four final third entries and four shots within an 8-minute window, generating an xG of 0.66 and culminating in Ilias Thorne’s goal at 86' (xG 0.333) [#1537]. Despite Redmond’s PPDA of 6.3 indicating aggressive pressing, Ironvale’s superior pass accuracy of 78.0% and higher possession (61.5%) in the last 10 minutes show effective rest-defense transitioning into overloads on the counter. This tactical mechanism highlights how Ironvale’s solidity and verticality countered Redmond’s high defensive line vulnerability, shifting momentum decisively in Ironvale’s favor.
